column3: The Hebrew title is only “Of David”; NASB sets “A Psalm of David” in braces before verse 1. “The refuge of my life” is rendered “the defense of my life.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a camp” is rendered “a host,” and “in this I am trusting” as “In spite of this I shall be confident.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to inquire” is rendered “to meditate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in His shelter” is rendered “in His tabernacle.”
The Hebrew reads “To You my heart said, ‘Seek My face’”; NASB restructures it as “When You said, ‘Seek My face,’ my heart said to You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will gather me” is rendered “will take me up.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a witness of violence” is rendered “such as breathe out violence.”
The Hebrew begins with an unfinished “Unless I had believed”; NASB supplies “I would have despaired.”
